E1235

Couldn't reach the registry index at `{url}`.

What

Couldn't reach the registry index at `{url}`.

Why

The Git registry transport rejects URL userinfo and query/fragment parameters before any network operation. Otherwise the Git operation failed because of network, authentication, or stale local-clone state; authentication comes from the host Git credential provider with path-scoped helper requests, and rendered endpoint details are redacted.

Fix

remove credentials and URL parameters, configure the host Git credential provider for the registry path, then check network access or set `JET_REGISTRY_URL` to a reachable mirror.
